name: FacilitiesHelpdeskTriage
tagline: Triage every FM request in seconds – priority matrix, SLA clocks and contractor routing in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete facilities-management helpdesk triage app for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages: impact × urgency priority matrix (P1–P5), response and resolution SLA clocks with 24×7 or business hours, keyword trade detection, critical-keyword flagging, trade-to-contractor routing with capacity and NTE approval, status rules, a status board and contractor workload.
features: Impact × urgency priority matrix with override
Response and resolution SLA meters (24×7 / business hours, at risk, paused, met/missed)
Keyword trade suggestion and critical keyword flags
Least-loaded contractor routing with capacity warnings
Status rules with required fields per status
Bulk triage, assign, status and CSV export
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
